Worth the trip.

Places in this region people keep coming back to. Not a ranking — a starting point.

  • Mole National Park

    Ghana's largest park: elephants, antelope and walking safaris.

    Official site ↗Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Larabanga Mosque

    Sudanese-style mud and stick architecture, among the oldest in the country.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Mognori Eco Village

    Canoe safaris and village stays on the edge of Mole.

  • Salaga

    A town carrying a heavy history as a trading and slave-market centre.

    Wikipedia ↗
